# PT Elgrano Garuda Angkasa (EGA)

> Specialty green coffee exporter based in Medan, North Sumatra, Indonesia. Sumatran Arabica and Robusta sourced from 500+ smallholder farmers, exported to 30+ countries since 2004.

## Products
- Gayo Arabica (Aceh)
- Mandheling (North Tapanuli)
- Lintong Green (North Sumatra)
- Fine Robusta (Sumatra)
